author: Codex-derived context, original measurements unchanged
synthesis_s_includes: Qwen generate_custom_voice + CUDA synchronization + WAV write; excludes shared model load and Python import overhead
load_scope: One shared model load, warm on-disk HuggingFace cache; repeated field in 3 rows must not be summed
time_to_first_segment_reason: Batch waveform API; first segment was not separately measured
gpu_metrics_scope: NVML global device0 snapshots before/after each sample; used_MB/total_MB are MiB (1024^2 bytes), not decimal MB
ram_metrics_scope: System-wide MemTotal-MemAvailable from /proc/meminfo, MiB; not Python process RSS or model-only memory

independent_gpu_observer.scope: Peaks of sampled read-only nvidia-smi records while TTS Python process is present, not guaranteed instantaneous physical maxima; NVML script snapshots are a separate series and are retained as measured

performance_limit: Batch RTF>1 with eager attention; low-latency streaming conversation is not received by these samples
reproducibility_limit: Same script and parameters reusable; random seed not pinned, byte-identical repeated audio or idempotence not demonstrated
